scope: All6frozen R126pairs, Raw and all4final models; retain local128readout plus larger actually saved context
valid_context: Remove80native pixels from each saved context edge, matching the frozen R126model halo. Apply identical crop to Raw and all candidates.
support: Full-field Raw pair independently estimates dominant source motion. It does not supply a desired search location or physical ground truth.
return_context_displacement_only_if: Unique joint match, positive fit, forward/reverse sum<=0.1px, valid full-field source match and context agreement with full-field Raw<=0.5px
local128: Always retain its estimate and validity. A rejected local128 reading is not silently converted into a valid local result by the broader context.
all_declined_cases: Return no reportable displacement, preserve diagnostic numbers and reasons
interpretation: Conditional dominant translation consistency on reused real photographs; not absolute measured stage motion or proof that image geometry is correct
